review_comments.body: **Required browser testing was skipped** This guard changes how clicks preserve the active editor, but the PR says no real-browser session was run. `CLAUDE.md` requires testing changes in the playground. Complete those playground checks before merging. **Context Used:** CLAUDE.md ([source](https://github.com/pdfme/pdfme/blob/main/CLAUDE.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know.
